auth.tagline: AI-assisted recruiting that helps you find exceptional people while keeping privacy at the heart of every decision.
auth.brandFoot: GDPR compliant · Hosted in the EU
auth.subtitle: Sign in to continue to your workspace.
auth.secureNote: Sign-in is handled by our identity provider. We never see your password.
auth.unavailableText: We could not reach the identity provider. Please check that it is running and try again.
auth.noAccessText: Your account does not have a TalentFlow role assigned. Please contact your administrator.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.subtitle: Manage job postings and track applicants across your hiring team.

empty.title: No jobs found
empty.text: Try changing your search or filters, or create your first job.

form.detailsText: Basic information candidates will see on the job posting.

form.descriptionText: Describe the opportunity, responsibilities and your team.

careers.title: Open positions
careers.subtitle: Find a role where you can do your best work. Every application is reviewed by a person.
careers.privacyNote: Your data is processed in the EU and only used for this application.

notFound.text: It may have been filled or closed.

apply.signInText: With a free candidate account you can apply in minutes and follow the status of your applications.
apply.staffText: You are signed in with a staff account. Please use a candidate account to apply for jobs.
apply.contactText: Name and email come from your account. Phone and location are optional.
apply.accountNote: To change your name or email, update your account profile.
apply.documentsText: Upload your CV as a PDF. A short cover letter is optional.

cv.label: CV (PDF)
cv.drop: Drop your CV here or click to browse

apply.coverLetterPlaceholder: Tell us briefly why this role interests you…
apply.coverLetterHint: Please do not include sensitive data such as health or religion.
apply.privacyText: We only process your data for this application and in the EU.
apply.consentLabel: I agree to the processing of my data
apply.consentText: TalentFlow may process my CV and contact details to evaluate this application, as described in the privacy policy. I can withdraw my consent and request deletion at any time in my candidate portal.
apply.aiNotice: An AI assistant may summarise your CV against the job requirements. It only makes suggestions; every decision is made by a person.

success.title: Application submitted
success.text: Thank you! We have received your application and will get back to you. You can follow its progress in your candidate portal.
